build_cell_classification_transform: build a torchvision Compose pipeline for cell image classification evaluation with center crop and self normalization
create_self_normalize_transform: create a PyTorch module that divides by 255 then normalizes image pixels by per-image mean and std
create_protein_channel_augmentation: create a transform that randomly rescales contrast of the protein channel in multi-channel cell images
create_random_channel_dropout: create a transform that randomly blackens one channel from multi-channel microscopy images with configurable probability
create_random_brightness_transform: create a transform that applies random brightness adjustment to each channel of a multi-channel image
